Q1: Which `claude_run` roles should get credential isolation, meaning an isolated filesystem plus a relay so the model never sees the pool token file?
Choices:
A) Only read-profile roles (MATERIALITY, SUMMARISER, LOG_SUMMARY, RETRO, the read-only heal/security/triage roles), as the finding scopes it. Write-profile roles get their own follow-up issue. (RECOMMENDED)
B) Every `claude_run` role, read and write profiles, in this change.
C) Only MATERIALITY, the role that posts bot PR advisories as described in the exploit.
Q2: When isolation can't start (Docker missing, the relay fails to come up, or the sandbox image fails to build), what should a read-profile role do?
Choices:
A) Fail closed using the existing engine fallback: exit 75, `AI_ENGINE_FALLBACK role=<R> reason=isolation_unavailable`, and continue on the codex/OpenCode path or the role's existing non-Claude default. Claude never runs unisolated. (RECOMMENDED)
B) Fail the calling step outright, with no fallback.
C) Run Claude unisolated as today and emit a `::warning::`.
**Note:** C leaves the reported exposure open whenever isolation is unavailable, so it conflicts with fixing this finding.
